content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I hope you're having a good day. If I download a program directly to a [product_name] Basis Module and then insert a memory card, will the program transfer automatically? If I then move the memory card to another [product_name] Basis Module, will the program be transferred to the new device?

When transferring a program to a [product_name], it is normally stored only on the device's internal Flash EPROM. If you want to save the program to an SD card, you need to select that option during the transfer process (refer to the instructions in the attachment).
Thank you very much for your help.
There’s a button you can use to show gratitude.

There is an alternative method: Insert the SD card into your PC and save the [product_name] diagram as a binary file on the SD card. Go to File > Save As, and save it as a *.bin file, not as an *.lsc file.
Hello, in older versions, when communicating via USB cable, I can't find an option to save to the SD card. Do you think the program will be transferred to the memory card in this case?
It would be helpful if you specify the exact [product_name] Soft Comfort version and [product_name] hardware (such as [article_no]). Without these details, it's difficult to give accurate advice.

For older [product_name] devices with a USB cable, programs cannot be written directly to the memory chip, since the cable occupies the slot where the memory card is normally inserted. You should transfer the program via USB cable to the device, remove the cable, insert the memory card, power on the device, access the main menu, select "card" and press OK. Then select "[product_name] > Card" and press OK.
Sorry if this seems like a simple question. I have a [product_name] device without a display—are there any solutions for this?
No offense meant, but providing all relevant information at once makes assisting you easier. Please try to include complete details next time.
Apologies again. I didn't fully understand your previous answer—does a solution exist or not?
I don't know of a solution for your case, otherwise I would have mentioned it. I only know the method for devices with a display.

Hi. Instead of the [product_name] PROM, you could use a [product_name] with a display. With that, you can transfer the program to the memory card and then use the card to copy the program to your [product_name] without display. Just one question: why do you need a memory card? These devices typically don't require one for normal use. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarity on how to transfer programs between [product_name] modules and memory cards, especially when using different device versions and when displays are not available. There is a lack of clarity about how [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] interacts with older hardware such as [article_no], particularly regarding SD card usage. The unclear transfer process and hardware limitations add to the confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a clear and easy method for transferring programs between [product_name] modules using memory cards, even when devices lack displays or the process is not directly visible in the software.
